name: test-support-evidence-in-one-file
description: A Go package carries test evidence when one of its files other than its test files imports the testing package, and then every file of the package is test-support code. A function of the file that imports it, which a test calls, and a function of the other file, which only that function calls, are test code that test code references and are reported under no code, and a function of the other file nothing calls is reported under the unused code its visibility selects.
